reason: Zero-configuration discovery bootstrap never creates the system-managed profiles a reported subnet should get, so all three tests time out waiting for them. Reproduced identically on an unmodified dev checkout at ae8fd9c0 with no in-flight branch involved — this is not a regression and not flaky, it is consistently red. Leading suspect: discovery_bootstrap.schedule_bootstrap's monitor_service._publish_soon does loop.create_task(...) without keeping a reference to the returned Task, which asyncio permits to be garbage-collected before it ever runs; neither the bootstrap's own success log nor its exception handler ever fires in the compose logs, consistent with the task body never executing.
